mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_user_roles ( id, user_id, institution_id, role, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{institutionId}, #{role}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, institution_id, role, created_at FROM tb_user_roles WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, institution_id, role, created_at FROM tb_user_roles WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.phone FROM tb_user_roles r JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.institution_id = #{institutionId} AND r.role = 'INSTITUTION_ADMIN' ORDER BY r.created_at ASC, r.id ASC
